Use case: ui-mockup. Full desktop DooKnow owner page, about 1440x1000. Image 1 is the actual content/controls/state/geometry authority. Image 2 supplies only flat palette, compact density and unified DooKnow header/rail hierarchy. Add the horizontal header DooKnow book identity | 笔记 above the note region, without adding actions. Narrow owner rail: O account, 笔记 selected, 最近, 收藏, 应用, bottom 回收站 and 设置. Keep notebook context sidebar exactly: 搜索笔记与目录, 新建 split button, 笔记本 plus/refresh, collapsed 00-Inbox and 30-Knowledge; preserve resize divider. No invented navigation. Preserve the note header: sidebar-collapse/back/forward, breadcrumb 笔记本 › 00-Inbox › 界面盘点样例-72ab64c8; 已保存, disabled undo/redo, favorite star, 分享, disabled 保存 Ctrl+S, … . No fake unsaved/auto-save/shared status. Preserve the baseline compact formatting controls in order: 标题 1 selector, B/I/strike, inline code, clear format, color, three alignments, quote, bullet/numbered/task lists, indent/outdent, link, code block, table, rule, image upload, whiteboard. Keep source conditional/disabled appearance and any overflow behavior; do not replace them with unrelated controls.
Preserve actual baseline flag-disabled tabs 编辑 / 预览 / 分屏 with 分屏 active and 章节目录 trigger. Main is two equal independent vertical panes with a thin divider, no right outline dock. Left pane label Markdown with 手动保存 · Ctrl+S, editable source including literal #/##/-/> markers. Right pane label 预览 with eye icon, rendered matching content. Both show exactly:
# 知识与行动

functionalInvariants: Every input constraint, action guard and important-state contract below is required. This plan is not a claim that incompatible states coexist or that source-only states ran.
Owner navigation may use the existing ToDoo two-level hierarchy; public guest and standalone reading may not contain private chrome.

POLICY Authenticated owner browser session; /api owner hook returns 401 if absent and 503 during maintenance. Mutations require configured Origin and CSRF token (apps/server/app.ts:141). No administrator/member role split is implemented for these owner surfaces.

UI structure rather than backend state count determines bitmap jobs. StateCoverage names exact component/bindings/guards and compact matrix rows; shared-pattern is not a claim that incompatible alternatives were visually proven together.
